resource.name: DHIS2 aggregate response to data value set
resource.description: How one aggregate QuestionnaireResponse becomes the DHIS2 data value set it is imported as, element by element. The map is the conversion contract a third party builds their own bridge from; it is not executed at runtime, and the rules whose meaning exceeds what a transform can state carry that on their own documentation.

resource.name: DHIS2 date labels
resource.description: The words a DHIS2 instance puts on the dates a form captures: the date the enrollment began, the date of the incident it follows, and the date the event happened. A slice is present only where the instance states a label, so a form the instance labels nothing on carries no extension at all, and a capture client then falls back to its own wording.

resource.name: DHIS2 description
resource.description: The free text a DHIS2 instance holds about the object a question or a group is asked from - the description of a data element, of a tracked entity attribute, or of a form section. It is guidance for the person filling the form, which is why it rides the item rather than the item's text, and it is present only where the instance states one.

resource.name: DHIS2 program collects an incident date
resource.description: Whether the DHIS2 tracker program a registration form enrols a person into collects the date of the incident the enrollment follows. True means every enrollment the program creates states that date and a response to this form carries D2IncidentAt; false means the program collects none and a response carries none. Only a registration form declares it, because only a program has enrollments.

Every DHIS2 program stage and data element this project nominates as feeding a section of an International Patient Summary, mapped onto that section's LOINC code. DHIS2 states no such mapping - it marks no data element as an immunisation, a problem, or an allergy - so the rows are this instance's own statement, made in [ips.sections] and published here so a consumer can audit which recorded values a served summary carries without holding that file.

Every value of the tracked entity attribute this project nominates as a person's sex, mapped onto the R4 administrative-gender code the register publishes as Patient.gender. DHIS2 states no such mapping, so the rows are this instance's own statement, made in [ips.identity] and published here so a consumer resolves a served gender without holding that file.
resource.name: DHIS2 sex values as FHIR administrative gender codes
DHIS2 stage is repeatable
resource.description: Whether one enrollment may capture this DHIS2 tracker program stage more than once. True means a person can be given several events of the stage - a follow-up visit, a repeat measurement - and false means the enrollment holds at most one. Only a tracker program stage form declares it, and it declares it either way, so a reader never has to guess.

resource.name: DHIS2 subject exists
resource.description: Whether the tracked entity a registration response is subject to is already held by the DHIS2 instance. True means the subject identifier names a person the instance already stores, and the response enrols that person rather than creating one - so it is imported as an enrollment alone, with no tracked entity beside it. Absent or false means the response creates the person it names, which is what a registration does by default.

resource.name: DHIS2 tracker registration response
resource.description: One submission of a DHIS2 tracker program's registration form: the tracked entity attributes captured when a person is enrolled, answered on the linkIds of the program's Questionnaire. The response mints both DHIS2 identities it creates - the tracked entity it is subject to and the enrollment its extension names - so a client can capture the enrollment's first stage events in the same breath, before either identity exists on the instance. A response stating D2SubjectExists enrols a person the instance already holds instead, and then mints the enrollment alone.
